name: Pritam Kumar Maurya
title: Software Development Engineer
headline: I build scalable backend systems and event-driven platforms for e-commerce and logistics — from Kafka microservices and Saga orchestration to AI-driven pricing intelligence.
availability: Open to interesting problems and conversations.
bio: I'm a Software Development Engineer with 3+ years of experience in e-commerce and logistics. I build scalable backend systems in **Java** and **Node.js**, design **event-driven microservices** with **Kafka**, and ship full-stack features with **React.js**.

I've contributed to ERP transformation, system optimisation and business-critical platforms spanning order management, inventory operations and AI-driven pricing intelligence. I care about distributed systems, clean system design, and software that holds up under real production load.
